data.title: Falcon Trainer Outlines Preparation Stages for Milwah Race at King Abdulaziz Falconry Festival
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- Preparing a falcon for the Milwah Race at the King Abdulaziz Falconry Festival 2026 begins well before it reaches the starting line, through training stages that raise its physical and psychological readiness and strengthen its ability to cover 400 meters in the fastest possible time.
    Falcon trainer Adel bin Abdullah Al-Otaibi said preparation requires training programs suited to each falcon's abilities and needs, combining traditional lure-based methods with modern aids such as training drones, while regulating its weight and building its fitness.
    He said that since falcons differ in temperament, trainers must monitor each bird's behavior and schedule sessions close to the actual heats to simulate competition conditions.
    At the starting line, the trainer must remove the hood, let the falcon arrange its feathers, and choose the release position that suits it, as any slip can cost fractions of a second that are hard to make up.
    The festival, organized by the National Center for Falcons in Malham, north of Riyadh, continues until November 30, with local and international falconers competing in 140 heats for cash prizes and the King Abdulaziz cups.
    
    -- SPA
